newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound interbank rates rise in short market.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound interbank rates rise in short market.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound rose on Sunday in a short private-sector market to between eight and 9-1/4 percent from between seven and 8-3/4 percent on Thursday, bankers said.
Some bankers attributed the shortage in pounds to Thursday's Central Bank offer of 182-day treasury bills worth 1.3 billion pounds ($382.9 million).
Average one-week rates were also higher at between 8-1/4 and nine percent from between eight and 8-5/8 percent. One banker even quoted rates as high as 9-1/16 percent.
The bankers said that public-sector banks kept their official minimum lending rate steady at 10-1/2 percent.
